/-- The least positive integer `n` such that `77` divides `(n + 2) * (n + 3)`. -/

theorem p07_least_divisible :
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)} p07_answer := by

  have hle18 : n ≤ 18 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt
  have hfalse : ¬ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3) := by
    have : n ≤ 18 := hle18
    interval_cases n using Nat
    all_goals

theorem p07_least_divisible :
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)} p07_answer := by

  · -- Prove 19 ∈ {n | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)}
    simp [p07_answer]
    constructor
    · -- 0 < 19
      norm_num

  · -- Prove ∀ n ∈ {n | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)}, 19 ≤ n

    by_contra h
    have h_lt : n < 19 := Nat.not_le.mp h

    have h_ge : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_of_lt h_pos

    -- Perform case analysis on n
    interval_cases n <;>
      norm_num [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at h_dvd <;>
      exact (by norm_num) h_dvd
